purpose: Improve mainline evidence support after v7: scope, conflicts and all operands of derived parameters. Paired generic policy guidance diagnostic, not HCL.

arms.R: v7 full raw input with unchanged v6 SYSTEM
arms.I: same full raw input, same tools and scorer; append fixed generic evidence checklist in adapter_v8.GUIDANCE

design: New paired cases; 6 evidence (3 answerable,2 conflict,1 missing),6 mapping (4 dose-times-frequency MME,1 direct anion gap,1 explicit RASS category). Interleave evidence and mapping pairs, balance R/I order within both families. Fresh state per episode, all raw distractors retained.
intervention: Single preregistered prompt package addressing requested-field/scope matching, within-scope contradiction, all-operand provenance and accurate transformation descriptions. No runtime oracle, new schema, changed formula, parser repair, model change or reduced scoring. The bundle cannot isolate each instruction effect.
model_visibility: Only task prompt, target, original schemas and complete raw evidence/state; I also sees the fixed generic checklist. No expected IDs, parameter values or answers supplied.
scoring: Reuse v7/v5 evaluator unchanged. Evidence exact selections or justified missing/conflict abstentions. Every abstention reason and accepted calculation including transformation text is manually audited before final scores. All numerical-only and unsupported results remain distinct.

decision_rules.evidence_ready_for_next_design: I at least 5/6 correct, both conflicts correct, no answerable-score decrease or more scope errors than R.
decision_rules.mapping_ready_for_next_design: I at least 5/6 trusted and at least 3/4 MME trusted, with direct/category controls not worse than R; audit all accepted results.
decision_rules.policy_improvement_signal: I at least 3/12 more final-correct than R and at least 2/4 more trusted MME cases; descriptive small-panel signal only.
decision_rules.otherwise: Report partial gains/regressions and unresolved components; no automatic follow-on experiment.

stop_conditions: CPU isolation/reference/scoring checks must pass before inference
One attempt per case and arm; no same-panel post-feedback revisions or extra model smoke
Task failures do not gate later cases or components
Provider/protocol/runtime/identity/guard failure or any original budget exhaustion stops remaining work with denominator preserved
After analysis and public source/report delivery stop; no HCL launch
limitations: New synthetic variants drawn from failure mechanisms observed in v7; development diagnostic rather than clinical/generalization benchmark
MME remains the existing single-oral-oxycodone evaluator subdomain
Prompt package changes both semantic guidance and prompt length; no isolated claim for one checklist rule
Full-input evidence and category examples do not establish broad autonomous medical reasoning
